supporting_observations.claim: During the review window, WS-EBROOKS-01 made repeated TCP connections to the internal proxy at 10.54.20.30:8080, including at 13:37:28, 13:39:24, 13:44:32, 13:49:25, 13:54:18, 13:59:51, 14:04:45, 14:09:24, and 14:14:38 UTC.
The listed Zeek records show connections to the proxy, but do not identify the external HTTPS destination or establish that each connection was an HTTPS tunnel.

Several proxy connections around 14:04:45 UTC had notably larger response volumes than the other listed recurring connections; one recorded 472,505 response bytes, with nearby flows recording 272,443 and 136,509 response bytes.
The recurring timing could be consistent with a scheduled software check, but the available records do not attribute these connections to the approved StockPilot updater or any other process.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-status information reports a collection outage for WS-EBROOKS-01 winsec and sysmon from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, so endpoint process and security-event attribution is unavailable for much of the alert period.
The supplied sensor-status information reports a proxy-log collection outage from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, preventing confirmation of CONNECT destinations and proxy transaction details for the period.
Zeek connection and DNS sensors are reported as available, but the provided records do not identify external destinations for the recurring proxy connections.
claims_not_established: Whether the recurring proxy connections were HTTPS tunnels, and which external hostnames or services they reached.
Which process or user initiated the connections.
Whether the activity was generated by approved software, such as StockPilot, or by unauthorized software.
Whether the larger response volumes near 14:04:45 were expected application content or suspicious downloads.
Whether the activity was malicious; the available network records alone do not establish intent or payload.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, including CONNECT target, authenticated user, URL or hostname where available, byte counts, and transaction timestamps.
Collect or recover WS-EBROOKS-01 process-creation and network-attribution telemetry for the outage period, including process image, command line, and parent process.
Review available TLS/SNI, DNS, and proxy records for the external destinations associated with the recurring connections.
Compare the recovered destinations and process attribution with the approved StockPilot updater and its expected update endpoint.
unrelated_findings: At 13:20:03 UTC, a UserAssist registry value on WS-EBROOKS-01 references the Windows PowerShell executable path. This is outside the alerted activity interval and does not establish the command or connect it to the proxy activity; assess separately if warranted. [T185-00001]
